articleTitle: Research on the Training Path of Compound Civil Engineering Talents Under the Guidance of Safety and Emergency Management Needs
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Digital Technology and Intelligent Education (ICDTIE)
abstract: With the increase of construction safety risks and the rise of emergency management needs, it is particularly important to cultivate compound civil engineering talents who understand safety and can respond to emergencies. This paper discusses the current situation of the cultivation of compound talents in civil engineering in colleges and universities at home and abroad, and compares and analyzes the traditional and compound civil engineering talent training modes. Based on the revision and improvement of talent training objectives, graduation requirements, curriculum addition, and main professional course content, the training path of safety + emergency + civil engineering compound talents is proposed. The research results of this paper can provide a new idea for the cultivation of compound civil engineering talents.

articleTitle: Enhancing University Students' ESG Competencies Through “Artificial Intelligence + Education”-A Case Study of ChatGPT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Digital Technology and Intelligent Education (ICDTIE)
abstract: Under the background of “artificial intelligence + education”, artificial intelligence is promoting the high-quality development of education, especially showing the potential in cultivating of environmental, social and governance (ESG) capabilities. This study takes ChatGPT as an example to explore how intelligent education can empower university students in enhancing their ESG capabilities. A comprehensive, multidimensional educational strategy is proposed, which includes the curriculum system centered around the integration of artificial intelligence and ESG, the reinforcement of practice-oriented teaching methods, the promotion of interdisciplinary and cross-sector research projects, and the establishment of internship mechanisms based on collaboration between academia and industry. These strategies aim to facilitate students' deep understanding of ESG principles and enhance their ability to apply these concepts in real-world scenarios.

articleTitle: The Construction of Teaching Mode Based on the Teaching Data Classification by the Baidu API and Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Digital Technology and Intelligent Education (ICDTIE)
abstract: This paper introduces the construction of teaching mode that applies the deep learning technology to the teaching data classification. Our method uses Baidu API's figure and OCR recognition service that are to output the general information of the teaching data. Then, we use deep learning models to classify the specific information. We fuse these to correctly classify the teaching information. We filter the new labels based on the objective of teaching mode and then use the corresponding samples to train the new models, which is to achieve the scalability. We utilized some public datasets for the experiment, and then we apply our method to the collection of teaching data to prove the scalability.

articleTitle: Weighted Average Transfer Loss: A Key Parameter for Effective Sound Quality Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Digital Technology and Intelligent Education (ICDTIE)
abstract: This research introduces a sound quality assessment method that integrates subjective evaluations with objective parameters, such as weighted average transmission loss (WATL), loudness, sharpness, roughness, and fluctuation. First, we conducted subjective assessments with 20 participants on 30 noise samples, establishing correlations between objective parameters and subjective perceptions. Then, the PSO-ELM model was used to predict sound quality in ducted noise systems. Findings demonstrate that the inclusion of WATL improves the model's predictive accuracy and efficiency, offering references for enhancing the acoustic performance of EV air conditioning systems and enhancing passenger comfort.

articleTitle: A Study of Logistics Customer Service Satisfaction Evaluation in the Context of Human-Robot Collaboration: Compatibility of AI Self-Service Q&A Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Digital Technology and Intelligent Education (ICDTIE)
abstract: With the development of artificial intelligence and ecommerce, the demand for logistics services is increasing and improving customer satisfaction is becoming more important. The emergence of self-service Q&A robots helps to alleviate these problems, but their compatibility in logistics customer service needs to be considered. This paper proposes a VIKOR evaluation method combining AHP-CRITIC to evaluate logistics customer service satisfaction under human-robot collaboration, aiming to improve customer service experience and industry competitiveness. First, an evaluation system including 5 primary indicators and 21 secondary indicators is established, and subjective and objective weights are calculated and combined based on questionnaire research. Finally, the VIKOR method is used to calculate the evaluation ranking of each system to provide a more reasonable ranking and promote the understanding and optimization of AI self-service Q&A robot services for e-commerce platforms and consumers.

articleTitle: A Teaching Figure Classification of Smart City Based on the Fusion of Multiple Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Digital Technology and Intelligent Education (ICDTIE)
abstract: Deep learning can be used to classify the figures of smart city, which is important to the analysis and teaching of city management. On the other side, the figures may be from different places and have different resolution ratio that cause the difficulty of training the deep learning models. To solve this problem, we proposed a new method to solve this problem. Our method uses multiple deep learning models and fuses the output of these models to achieve high accuracy while ensuring good scalability. As the experimental results prove, our method can achieve higher accuracy than the existing ones on the public datasets and ensures high scalability on the teaching datasets.

articleTitle: Research on the Statistical Analysis Model of the Medical Student Career Mission Scale Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Digital Technology and Intelligent Education (ICDTIE)
abstract: Aiming at the multimodal, high-dimensional, and big data characteristics of the medical student professional mission scale data, a multi factor fusion statistical analysis model for the medical student professional mission scale data is proposed. The proposed method first uses statistical correlation theory to test the reliability of the scale, and obtains the correlation coefficients of the population and dimensions of each scale data. Then, using the method of factor correlation analysis, the principal component cumulative variance contribution rate, average variance extraction for each dimension, and multiple fitting indices of the scale are obtained. Finally, the results of the scale data statistical model were mapped to three dimensions: externalization behavior, intrinsic quality, and self-identity of medical students' sense of career mission for validation. The results showed that the proposed data statistical model has significant reliability and validity, and can effectively measure the sense of career mission of medical students.

articleTitle: Research on Abnormal Data Evaluation and Repair Method Based on TE-WAF Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Digital Technology and Intelligent Education (ICDTIE)
abstract: In power systems, the accuracy, completeness and timeliness of data are crucial for equipment monitoring, fault diagnosis and decision support. However, outliers often appear in power data due to a variety of factors, such as equipment failure, communication outages, or external interference. These abnormal data may not only lead to wrong analysis results, but also affect the safety and reliability of the power system. Therefore, in view of the inaccuracy, incompleteness and untimely outliers in power data, this paper proposes an abnormal data evaluation and repair method based on TE-WAF algorithm. In this method, a comprehensive evaluation model of abnormal data is proposed by combining various identification models. Considering the characteristics of the three types of abnormal data, this paper evaluates the data in the order of incomplete, untimely and inaccurate data, and uses confusion matrix to evaluate the accuracy rate to verify the effect of the model. Then, weighted mean correction model and ARIMA prediction model are used to classify and correct the labeled abnormal data. By combining the smoothing characteristics of the former and the time series prediction ability of the latter, different types of abnormal data can be corrected more comprehensively, the limitations of a single model can be avoided, and the advantages of the two models can be maximized to improve the overall correction effect of abnormal data. Better data quality to support subsequent analysis and decision making. The experimental results show that the Triple evaluationweighted ARIMA Fusion (TE-WAF) algorithm proposed in this paper can effectively improve the Evaluation and correction effect of power data outliers, so as to provide reliable data guarantee for the stable operation of power system.

articleTitle: Teaching Reform of New Engineering Deep Learning Courses Combining Ideology and Politics Leading, Project Driving and Intelligent Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Digital Technology and Intelligent Education (ICDTIE)
abstract: In order to enhance the practical innovation ability of new engineering students, this paper based on the educational policy of innovation driven development, combined with current state of teaching and learning in deep learning courses, analyzes in-depth the difficulties of deep learning courses in terms of the difficulty of integrating ideological and political elements, the poor foundation of theoretical system, the difficulty of experimental teaching, the wide range of application needs and the fast knowledge updating, etc., and puts forward the teaching reform of new engineering deep learning courses that combines ideological and political leading, project driving and Intelligent Evaluation. The teaching reform and practice research of deep learning courses is carried out from the aspects of ideological and political teaching objectives, ideological and political teaching cases, ideological and political teaching methods, project selection mode, project learning mode, project practice mode, decision tree data processing, decision tree model construction and decision tree model optimization, in order to provide reference for colleges and universities to improve the teaching quality of deep learning courses. Through competency assessment system, student feedback results and academic competitions achievements, it is shown that the reformed teaching can stimulate students' interest in learning, which not only improves students' independent learning ability and practical hands-on ability, but also helps to improve students' innovation ability and overall qualities.

articleTitle: Bibliometrics-Based Visualisation and Trend Analysis of Regional Culture and Urban Image Design
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Digital Technology and Intelligent Education (ICDTIE)
abstract: In the context of globalization and informatization, urban development has ush-ered in new opportunities, with Regional Culture (RC) and City Image Design (CID) emerging as new focal points of urban competition. This study utilizes 411 articles sourced from the Web of Science Core Collection (WoSCC) database as the data foundation. Employing visualization software such as CiteSpace 6.3.R1 and VOSviewer, it analyzes literature themed around “regional culture (RC)”, “city image (CI)”, and “design” from January 1, 2004, to October 16, 2024. The finding s reveal that: ① China, the United States, and certain EU countries demonstrate significant innovation and influence in this research field, with nota-ble contributions from scholars such as Li, L., Li, Z., and Wang, Y.; ② Research hotspots concentrate on urban ecological governance, ecological design, heritage tourism management, and community cultural sustainability, reflecting a comprehensive consideration of multidimensional urban factors and promoting a deeper understanding of urban renewal and spatial planning; ③ Over the past two dec-ades, research on RC and CID has shown an upward trend, evolving through phases of initial growth, fluctuating growth, and stable development; ④ Future trends are centered on diversified and personalized presentation methods, along-side an emphasis on deep-level interpretation and distinctive features of urban culture. This study not only provides a comprehensive perspective on the re-search dynamics within the RC and CID fields but also offers guidance for future research directions.

articleTitle: MindScape Continuum: Advancing Online Counseling with Bert-Based Strategy Classification and Professional Helping Skills
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Digital Technology and Intelligent Education (ICDTIE)
abstract: The prevalence of mental health issues has led to a surge in demand for accessible and efficient psychological support. As technology advances, there is a growing interest in using large language models (LLMs) for online counseling. However, current LLM-based conversation systems are limited to empathetic conversations and lack the depth and variety of strategies used in professional counseling practice. To address this, we introduce a dataset for Psychological Counseling with Diverse Strategies (PCDS), an extension of PsyQA, and it contains over 39,000 data points categorized into six core helping skills for specific scenarios. This paper presents MindScape Continuum, a novel framework for integrating psychological helping skills into online counseling. It utilizes BERTbased models for text categorization and end-to-end conversation generation. Our experiments demonstrate that this approach achieves high accuracy in strategy categorization, enhancing the generation of targeted and professional responses in counseling conversations. By incorporating counseling helping skills into the prompt design, increasing the relevance and coherence of the model's responses. Although challenges remain with open-ended questions and semantic ambiguity, the MindScape Continuum framework shows promise in optimizing the application of psychological knowledge in AI-assisted counseling. It represents a significant step towards developing a next-generation online counseling tool.
